_README: FROZEN PRE-REGISTRATION for the prospective reward-repair experiment.
Everything below was fixed BEFORE the sealed evaluation split was generated
and before any arm was trained. Nothing here may be changed after the sealed
split is opened. If something must change, bump `revision`, record why in
`amendments`, and state in the paper that the change happened after freeze.
The point of this file is that a reader can check what we committed to
against what we report. It is the direct answer to the failure this paper
documents: a reward that looked fine by every metric we chose after seeing

environment._note: canonical machine for every number that reaches the paper. Numbers from other machines are not mixed into a table; knn12 rho differed 0.543 vs 0.604 between machines on identical deterministic code, which is why this is pinned.

_backend_rationale: The yosys backend reached 33/60 on the byte contract and would ALSO need
an RTLIL-specific feature extractor, because the features below count
Verilog tokens that `proc; opt_clean` no longer represents. It is future
work. The claim we make is LEXICAL invariance, not canonical hardware
canonicaliser._suite_note: `reflow` is the attack the policy actually used (one statement per line) and `pack` is its inverse, so the exploited channel is in the suite by construction.
mandatory_recheck: --check-traces over the FULL corpus is mandatory and must be re-run
whenever the corpus or the tokenizer changes. Two tokenizer gaps ('0 and
$signed) passed the entire byte-level contract -- idempotence,
metamorphic equality, feature equality -- while emitting invalid Verilog,
because a consistently broken output is still self-consistent. A token-
level guard was built for this and DOES NOT WORK; compiling the output is

reward.name: rf_struct
_feature_provenance: n_lines DELETED -- it is the channel the policy exploited and has no
hardware meaning. nb_assign replaced: it was line-anchored. accum
replaced: it matched a signal-NAME regex. n_loops / loop_bound_* ADDED
after Check A failed on the median family, on TRAINING data only, before
this freeze: two med5 candidates differing only in `i < 5` versus `i < 4`
measured 60.4 and 38.3 MHz with identical feature vectors. A loop bound
determines the synthesised hardware and no layout change can alter it.
The representation was moved; the thresholds were not.

training_rows._note: held-out and sealed designs are excluded by gen_sft_corpus.is_holdout(); invariant #3

selection_rule: Design-blocked nested cross-validation on TRAINING rows only.
The v8 optimized distribution and the sealed split are NOT consulted.
Primary metric: within-design ranking on training designs with genuine
PPA diversity. Secondary: worst-design calibration, seed stability,
fraction of non-flat reward groups. One-standard-error rule for ties.
DISCLOSURE: RandomForest was noticed while inspecting v8 outputs. That
makes it a hypothesis generated post-hoc; the prospective run on the
sealed split is what tests it.

check_a._purpose: does canonicalisation destroy the information needed to ORDER candidates?
check_a._med_caveat: med at 21.7% is a MARGINAL pass against a 25% ceiling, on the one family GRPO already gains nothing on. Report it as marginal; never quote 1.3% alone.

check_b._name: reward-resolution failure (a diagnosed null, not an expected outcome)
check_b.eligible_group: >= 2 oracle-correct candidates with distinct canonical feature vectors
check_b.resolved_group: rf_struct prediction range over the group > 5 MHz
check_b.plateau_diagnosed_if: < 20% of eligible groups resolved over the fixed run

sealed_split.layout: 2 designs in each of 5 families x 2 regimes (interp, extrap)
sealed_split.generation: gen_accelerator_catalog parameterisations drawn from a committed seed; NO hand selection
sealed_split.open_condition: after BOTH seeds of ALL arms are complete and every configuration is frozen
sealed_split._honest_limitation: These are unseen PARAMETERISATIONS from the same generator families. That repairs adaptive reuse of the old 30-design set. It does NOT establish cross-template generalisation, and the paper must say so. External circuits are a TCAD extension.

training_protocol.matched_on: non-flat optimizer updates, NOT attempted steps
training_protocol._logging_rationale: The invariance gate's operational columns were computed over RECONSTRUCTED (policy, design) sets of deduplicated evaluation candidates, not the actual 8-sample training groups. They are counterfactual decision-sensitivity metrics. This logging makes the prospective numbers direct measurements instead.

evaluation._synthesis_caveat: WNS-derived from a single implementation run. NOT timing closure. All comparisons relative, identical flow.
primary_endpoints: real Fmax with incorrect scored 0 (equal sample cost)
evaluation.uncertainty: paired design-level bootstrap CIs; training seeds reported separately, never pooled as independent samples

criteria: canonical GRPO improves real equal-sample Fmax over SFT in BOTH regimes
the improvement appears in BOTH training seeds
retains a substantial part of the original GRPO gain
does not reproduce the late reward / real-Fmax divergence
success_criteria._note: It does NOT have to beat the original MLP's peak Fmax. 'Slightly less peak improvement, but a valid and stable reward' is a good result.

stop_rules: One canonicaliser version after this freeze.
NO tuning after the sealed results are opened.
If a different structural exploit appears: report the boundary, do not build repair v2.
If seeds disagree: report the instability, do not add seeds until significance appears.
No new corpora, boards, EDA tools, reward architectures or mutation families before submission.
